contamination_barrier_usage_policy.policy: Every active contamination barrier means the referenced artifact is planning/debug evidence only, not a validated design input. A barrier may be superseded only by checker-promoted replacement artifacts plus SACG memory reconciliation. Historical, closed, superseded, or rejected records are recovery evidence only.
contamination_barrier_usage_policy.same_stage_retry_policy: No retry_reconciliation_contract for the current repair stage was supplied, so all open retry requests in state_summary.sacg_memory_truth remain current blockers until accepted replacement evidence is promoted.

executable_actions.on_failure: Block handoff to repair planners and request detailed checker rows; do not infer pass or clear any SACG blocker.
executable_actions.rationale: Produce checker-grounded repair_evidence_classification_report, failed_checker_to_constraint_map, retry_request_blocker_table, and contamination_barrier_usage_policy from the visible state_summary.sacg_memory_truth without promoting rejected artifacts.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep retry_request.0001 open, keep Stage6 barriers active, do not rerun Stage7; if failure is caused by missing or ambiguous tool protocols, route to the approval-gated protocol repair action.
executable_actions.rationale: retry_request.0001 and contamination_barrier.0001-0013 show that the current Stage6 verification artifacts are rejected. Regenerate or refine the Stage6 verification plan and artifact contract from trusted Stage5 manifest, tool protocols, and case_adapter; consume rejected Stage6 artifacts only as negative provenance evidence to supersede.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not close or supersede barriers; keep Stage7 and Stage8 artifacts blocked from validated downstream consumption.
executable_actions.rationale: Active contamination barriers may only be superseded after replacement artifacts pass their current-stage checkers. This action reconciles retry_request.0001 and Stage6 barriers only after repaired Stage6 artifacts are checker-promoted.

executable_actions.on_failure: Route the real-tool output to contract-guided failure localization and Stage8 bounded repair; do not promote the leaf certificate or proceed to single-transformer-layer checks.
executable_actions.rationale: Stage7 operator-leaf evidence must be rerun under a promoted Stage6 verification artifact contract. Previous Stage7 verification_result, real_tool_results, debug_closure, and promotion_certificate are contaminated and may be used only as debug hints.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not issue free-form RTL or template repair; request Stage6 schema repair or bounded backtrack if causal localization cannot be produced.
executable_actions.rationale: If the clean operator-leaf rerun fails, localize the earliest causal boundary/module before proposing bounded repair. This preserves the operator/leaf-first layer of the hardware debug loop.

executable_actions.on_failure: Route single-layer evidence to Stage8 bounded localization/repair; do not proceed to board/AXI/DDR/Vivado/runtime stages.
executable_actions.rationale: The next verification layer is the connected single-transformer-layer kernel, and it may run only after operator-leaf promotion under the clean Stage6 contract. This action prevents skipping to board-level work.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep Stage6, Stage7, and Stage8 promotion blocked until approved evidence or a supplied protocol update exists.
executable_actions.rationale: If Stage6 repair cannot satisfy tool_protocol_check or hierarchical_verification_plan_check using supplied artifacts, changing the gate DAG, verification hierarchy, or real-tool protocol assumptions crosses the human-boundary policy.

executable_actions.on_failure: Escalate to repair.boundary_authority_gate; do not allow runtime bitstream, board runtime, or Vivado promotion from contaminated evidence.
executable_actions.rationale: The backend app-shell target discovery policy is itself under Stage6 contamination, and current Stage7/Stage8 artifacts are not promotable. Board/AXI/DDR/Vivado/runtime work must remain blocked until operator-leaf and single-transformer-layer closure pass under a promoted contract.

failed_checker_to_constraint_map.bounded_repair: Repair and promote Stage6 verification artifacts from trusted Stage5 manifest, input.tool_protocols, and case_adapter before any Stage7 rerun.
failed_checker_to_constraint_map.evidence: Stage6 verification_plan, verification_artifact_contract, and llm_action_audit have rejected producer transitions and cannot be used as validated downstream inputs.

failed_checker_to_constraint_map.bounded_repair: After Stage6 repair and SACG reconciliation, rerun operator-leaf evidence under the clean contract, then single-transformer-layer closure before board work.
failed_checker_to_constraint_map.evidence: Stage7 verification cannot be promoted while sacg_memory_truth lists active Stage6/Stage7/Stage8 contamination barriers and open retry requests. Historical selected operator-leaf pass claims are non-promotable.

failed_checker_to_constraint_map.bounded_repair: Schedule required real-tool evidence only after Stage6 contract is promoted.
failed_checker_to_constraint_map.evidence: case_vcs_functional is null and candidate note states not_run real tools are evidence gaps, not automatic repair failures.

Historical recent_failure_lessons and recent_stage_outcomes are recovery evidence only; they do not add blockers beyond the truth object.

The visible failure states that artifact.stage6.verification_plan, artifact.stage6.verification_artifact_contract, and artifact.stage6.llm_action_audit have rejected producer transitions and cannot be used as validated downstream inputs.

verification_agent_decision_check is classified as Stage7 rerun dependency plus SACG trust-state blocker. Any historical claim that selected operator-leaf evidence passed is non-promotable while Stage6/Stage7/Stage8 artifacts remain under active contamination barriers.

retry_request.0001 is the earliest open retry request and is classified as Stage6 verification contract repair: the Stage6 gate DAG or tool protocol contract is incomplete and must be repaired from trusted Stage5 manifest, input.tool_protocols, and case_adapter before Stage7 rerun.

retry_request.0002, retry_request.0004, and retry_request.0006 are classified as Stage7 rerun dependencies. They block artifact.stage7.verification_result until a clean Stage6 contract exists and the selected real-tool/checker gates pass under that contract.

retry_request.0003 and retry_request.0005 are classified as Stage8 bounded repair completion blockers. Existing Stage8 repair_plan and repair_execution_report artifacts are not validated design inputs; they can only guide bounded repair planning until superseded and followed by Stage7 rerun.

contamination_barrier.0001 through contamination_barrier.0013 cover rejected Stage6 verification artifacts and are classified as Stage6 contract/provenance barriers. These artifacts may inform what to supersede but cannot satisfy Stage7 required inputs.

contamination_barrier.0014 through contamination_barrier.0017, contamination_barrier.0020 through contamination_barrier.0023, and contamination_barrier.0026 through contamination_barrier.0029 cover rejected Stage7 result/tool/debug/promotion artifacts and are classified as Stage7 rerun barriers. They are debug evidence only and cannot establish hardware correctness or promotion.

contamination_barrier.0018 and contamination_barrier.0024 cover rejected Stage8 repair_plan artifacts and are classified as Stage8 bounded repair workflow barriers. contamination_barrier.0019 and contamination_barrier.0025 cover repair_execution_report artifacts and are classified as Stage7 rerun-after-repair barriers.

candidate_stage_artifact.diagnostics.case_vcs_functional is null and the note says not_run real tools are evidence gaps, not automatic repair failures. This is classified as required real-tool evidence gap, not as hardware correctness evidence.

The three-layer hardware debug loop remains active: first operator/leaf modules, then the connected single-transformer-layer kernel, then board-accurate AXI/DDR wrapped system. Current blockers prevent promotion beyond operator-leaf rerun planning.

Cross-layer consistency remains at risk across verification plan, tool protocol, data order, numeric comparison, memory/runtime configuration, and board deployment because the Stage6 verification contract and backend app-shell target discovery policy are both under active Stage6 contamination barriers.
proposed_actions: Preserve all 29 active contamination barriers and classify affected artifacts as planning/debug evidence only until checker-promoted replacements exist.

Handoff first to repair.stage6_contract_repair_architect to regenerate and promote Stage6 verification plan, verification artifact contract, gate selector, audit, and schemas from trusted Stage5 and input tool/case artifacts.

After Stage6 checkers pass, reconcile SACG retry requests and contamination barriers using stage_retry_request_check and stage_artifact_trust_barrier_check; do not clear barriers from memory without promoted replacement artifacts.
Handoff to repair.targeted_replay_planner to rerun Stage7 operator-leaf real-tool evidence under the clean Stage6 contract; treat prior Stage7 results only as debug hints.
If operator-leaf rerun fails, perform contract-guided failure localization and create a bounded Stage8 repair context before proposing any template or code repair.
Only after operator-leaf promotion may the team run the single-transformer-layer kernel checks; board/AXI/DDR/Vivado/runtime actions remain blocked until lower layers pass.

Escalate for approval if Stage6 repair needs changed verification hierarchy, new tool protocol assumptions, architecture/pipeline/memory/numeric/template changes, or consumption of contaminated artifacts as validated inputs.

retry_request_blocker_table.required_resolution: Repair/promote Stage6 gate DAG and tool protocol contract from artifact.stage5.design_artifact_manifest, artifact.input.tool_protocols, and artifact.input.case_adapter; then reconcile SACG barriers.
Rerun selected Stage7 gates only after Stage6 contract promotion and Stage8 bounded repair completion if still applicable.
Complete or supersede bounded repair plan, then rerun Stage7; do not consume Stage8 plan as validated design input.
Reconcile with other Stage7 retry requests after clean Stage7 rerun evidence passes required gates.
Supersede stale repair plan with checker-grounded bounded repair context or close only after promoted Stage7 rerun.
Rerun operator-leaf under clean Stage6 contract; then execute single-transformer-layer closure before any board work.

risks: If any active-contaminated Stage6 artifact is consumed as a valid contract, all downstream Stage7 and Stage8 evidence will inherit invalid provenance.
If contaminated Stage7 real_tool_results or operator_leaf_promotion_certificate are treated as pass evidence, the system could falsely promote hardware without checker-bound real-tool evidence.
If Stage8 repair_execution_report is treated as closure evidence without a subsequent Stage7 rerun, repairs may be unverified and retry_request.0003 or retry_request.0005 will remain unresolved.
If the team skips directly to single-layer, board, AXI/DDR, Vivado, or runtime work before clean operator-leaf rerun, the hierarchical verification policy and deployment constraints are violated.

Tool protocol or case_adapter incompleteness may require human-boundary approval if the repair needs new verification gates, altered real-tool requirements, or assumptions not present in the supplied constraints.

The compact candidate failure rows omit detailed diagnostics, so later specialists must request detailed checker output if they need module-level localization; this classifier does not infer missing detail as an additional blocker.

The bounded path is Stage6 verification contract repair and promotion, SACG trust-state reconciliation, Stage7 operator-leaf rerun under the clean contract, then single-transformer-layer closure before any board/AXI/DDR/Vivado/runtime work.
